notes.title: High School of Memories now with Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
[h1] Steam Achievements are now available for High School of Memories! [/h1] 

After each chapter, you will be awarded Steam Achievements! There's 13 to collect in all, 
and you'll get a full list of Achievements just from reading the story! 

Thank you so much for checking us out and supporting us! 

[h1] Spirit and Katana will also have Steam Achievements! [/h1] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1741620/
